name: Accessible Interface
description: Builds inclusive semantic interfaces with keyboard and assistive-technology support.
guidance: Use semantic landmarks, a logical heading hierarchy, descriptive labels and meaningful alternative text.
Preserve keyboard access, visible focus and sufficient contrast; respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do not use clickable decorative elements in place of real links or buttons.
completion_checks: The document declares language and title and uses semantic landmarks.
Interactive controls have understandable accessible names.
Images have meaningful alt text or are explicitly decorative.
